correctness.rationale: The marked chord is uniformly distributed among endpoint pairs; r-clique count conditionally splits into disjoint cliques avoiding or including it. Including cliques require one prescribed mutually crossing pairing of r−1 endpoints from each arc, probability the reciprocal of the finite odd product. The binomial product is nondecreasing and nonconstant in shorter-arc size, so covariance is strictly positive by an independent-copies identity for every n>=r>=3. Exact fractions and exhaustive all-matchings n=3..6 support the derived triangle closed form; finite checks are not used as a proof for infinite n.
